summary: The production --phase all path terminates after PA/PB and never produces the required Qwen3 embedding artifacts.
Figures default to eval_results/issue_2564/pe while analysis writes eval_results/issue_2564, so the production command crashes.
PA, PB, and PC have not run on a real GPU slice; the recorded evidence is import/dry-run/synthetic only.
Analyzer ignores axis floor_met, falls back to all non-fired values, and leaves several headline read families unfiltered.
Judge values with missing post-retry checks can be marked fired despite the approved mandatory-undetermined rule.
Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 loaders do not receive the revisions recorded in manifests and resume fingerprints.
Hero omits the raw reliability ceiling whenever ceiling normalization is suppressed.
